evals.prompt: I haven't touched this project in about a year. Can you do a full review of the codebase — dependencies, logic, UI, UX — and give me a step-by-step plan with sprints and milestones to bring it up to date?
evals.expected_output: MODERNIZATION_REPORT.md and MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md written at the repo root; baseline recorded with a GREEN/AMBER/RED verdict; all 10 dimensions dispositioned; a 5-phase plan with sprints, tasks, and milestones.
expectations: The run establishes the Phase 0 baseline (build, tests, pass rate) BEFORE auditing any dimension
Both MODERNIZATION_REPORT.md and MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md exist at the target repo root
The report's dimension coverage table lists all 10 dimensions with Audited or Not Assessed + reason
Every finding cites path:line, or is marked repo-wide only for absence-of-thing findings
The plan contains phases P0 through P4, each with at least one sprint and a measurable milestone
Every task has at least 2 acceptance criteria, one asserting the test suite is still green
Every task carries a Closes: line naming finding IDs, or names the milestone it enables

No repo-writing delegate is invoked during the audit — test-coverage, devops-pipeline, security-setup, doc-manager, code-review mode clean, and code-review mode cleanup are each named in a plan task instead
git diff --stat is empty — no tracked file's content was modified
Any new file is one of the two reports, the declared CODE_REVIEW.md artifact, or a probe byproduct, and all of them are enumerated in the report's Artifacts section
dont-make-me-think is invoked in review mode only — its Redesign Mode never runs and no UI source file is edited

evals.prompt: This repo has become a mess after dozens of tasks with no cleanup. Audit the whole thing and tell me how to get it to a better, up-to-date version — I want something testable, not a wish list.
evals.expected_output: Full audit plus a plan whose every task has command-checkable acceptance criteria, a dependency table with no cycles, and an explicitly stated critical path.
expectations: Findings are severity-ranked Critical/High/Medium/Low and the summary counts equal the finding table rows
Every acceptance criterion in the plan is checkable by a command, file state, or count — no 'code is cleaner' style criteria
The dependency table references only task IDs that exist and contains no cycles
The critical path is stated explicitly with its task chain
Dead-code and duplication work is scheduled as a task invoking code-review mode cleanup, and cleanup is never run during the audit

evals.prompt: Update all the dependencies in this project to the latest versions and plan the rest of the modernization work.
evals.expected_output: No dependency is actually upgraded. A classified DEP table plus upgrade waves; majors become one task each with a named migration source.
expectations: No upgrade command is executed — no npm update, ncu -u, pip install -U, cargo update, poetry update, or equivalent
The skill states up front that upgrades are planned rather than applied, and why
Each dependency is classified with gap type, risk, blast radius, and an upgrade wave
Security patches, the patch/minor batch, and each major are separated into distinct waves
Each major-version task appears alone and names its migration source, or is flagged as a spike when no guide was retrievable

evals.prompt: Review this codebase and plan the modernization. (Target: a headless Go CLI with no frontend files, no test suite, and a build that currently fails to compile.)
evals.expected_output: Baseline RED recorded; audit continues; UX marked Not Assessed — no UI detected; missing test suite reported as Critical; Sprint 0 restores baseline-green and everything else depends on it.
expectations: The baseline verdict is RED and the audit continues rather than aborting
The UX dimension is marked 'Not Assessed — no UI detected' and no UX findings are invented
The absent test suite is reported as a Critical finding and lands in phase P0
The plan's Sprint 0 restores baseline-green and later phases depend on milestone M0
The Limitations section names every Not Assessed dimension and every missing tool

evals.prompt: Audit this repo — but I only care about dependencies and test coverage right now.
evals.expected_output: Only DEP and TEST are audited; the other 8 dimensions appear in the coverage table as 'Not Assessed — out of requested scope'; the plan covers only findings from the two audited dimensions.
expectations: Exactly the DEP and TEST dimensions are audited
The other eight dimensions appear in the coverage table marked Not Assessed with the out-of-scope reason
No findings are produced for dimensions that were not audited
The plan still uses the fixed P0-P4 skeleton, with empty phases collapsed to a one-line note rather than renumbered

evals.prompt: Review this PR for bugs and security issues before I merge it.
evals.expected_output: Handled by code-review mode review — a prioritized findings report on the diff. No baseline probe, no MODERNIZATION_REPORT.md, no sprint plan.
expectations: codebase-modernizer does not trigger; the request routes to code-review
No MODERNIZATION_REPORT.md or MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md is written
No 5-phase sprint plan is produced for a single-diff review

evals.prompt: Here's the PRD for our new product. Break it into sprint tasks with dependencies.
evals.expected_output: Handled by tasks-generator — tasks.md from the PRD. No codebase audit, no baseline probe, no dependency scan.
expectations: codebase-modernizer does not trigger; the request routes to tasks-generator
No baseline probe or dependency scan runs against the repo
The output is PRD-derived tasks, not an audit report

evals.prompt: Audit this codebase and give me the modernization plan. (Environment: every delegate skill is installed and available — code-review, dont-make-me-think, test-coverage, devops-pipeline, security-setup, doc-manager.)
evals.expected_output: The audit invokes only the three non-mutating delegates. No hook, workflow, test, or docs file is created; the six writing skills appear only as named invocations inside plan tasks.
expectations: No pre-commit hook or .pre-commit-config.yaml is created (security-setup and devops-pipeline are not invoked)
No file under .github/workflows/ is created or modified
No test file is generated (test-coverage is not invoked)
No documentation file is rewritten (doc-manager is not invoked)
No CLEAN_CODE_AUDIT.md is produced (code-review mode clean is not invoked)
dont-make-me-think runs in review mode only — no UI source file is edited
Each of the six writing skills is named as the invocation in at least one plan task
git diff --stat is empty at the end of the run

evals.prompt: Audit this monorepo and plan the modernization. (Target: packages/web/package.json and services/api/go.mod, with no manifest at the repo root.)
evals.expected_output: Nested manifests are detected and probed per package; DEP is never reported as 'no ecosystems' while manifests exist.
expectations: Both the nested npm package and the nested Go module appear as separate DEP ecosystem rows
The run does not report 'Ecosystems detected: none' while nested manifests exist
dep_scan.sh is re-run per package directory, or the unprobed packages are explicitly marked Not Assessed with the reason
The go.mod declared Go version is assessed for EOL rather than reported as 'no runtime declared'

evals.prompt: I inherited this Rails app from a contractor who left 8 months ago. Give me a refactoring and upgrade plan I can actually work through sprint by sprint.
evals.expected_output: Full audit plus a P0-P4 plan sized into sprints, with the Ruby/Rails dependency and runtime currency assessed and majors split one per task.
expectations: The skill triggers on the inherited/neglected-codebase framing without the user saying 'modernize' or 'stale'
Phase 0 records a baseline verdict before any dimension is audited
The Ruby ecosystem is detected and its runtime version checked against current stable for EOL
Any Rails major-version bump is its own task naming a migration source, never batched with other upgrades
Sprints are sized to 5-10 tasks each and every task carries an effort estimate
Both MODERNIZATION_REPORT.md and MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md are written; git diff --stat is empty
